ssc.name: SSC CGL
ssc.full_name: Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level

Tier IV: Computer Proficiency Test / Skill Test (if applicable)

strategy: Start with NCERT books for General Awareness (Class 6–12)
Practice 30–50 Quant questions daily from RS Aggarwal
Solve previous year papers for Reasoning patterns
Read one English editorial daily for vocabulary and comprehension
Give 2 mock tests per week and analyze mistakes
Focus on Tier I first — it is the gateway exam

ibps_po.name: IBPS PO
ibps_po.full_name: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection – Probationary Officer
ibps_po.eligibility: Graduate from any recognised university (min. 60% for some banks)
strategy: Strengthen Data Interpretation — it fetches maximum marks in Mains
Practice puzzle-based Reasoning daily (seating, scheduling)
Read The Hindu / Economic Times for Banking Awareness
Improve reading speed for English (aim 250 words/min)
Attempt 3 full mocks per week after basics are done
Learn banking terminology: REPO rate, CRR, SLR, NPA, etc.

rrb_ntpc.name: RRB NTPC
rrb_ntpc.full_name: Railway Recruitment Board – Non Technical Popular Categories
rrb_ntpc.eligibility: 12th Pass / Graduate depending on the post
strategy: Master Indian Railways history and facts for GK
Arithmetic (percentage, profit/loss, SI/CI) is heavily tested
Focus on Static GK: capitals, rivers, awards, sports
Practice coding-decoding and series for Reasoning
Attempt RRB-specific previous papers available online
Current Affairs: last 6 months before exam

upsc_cse.name: UPSC CSE
upsc_cse.full_name: Union Public Service Commission Civil Services Examination
strategy: NCERT foundation (Class 6–12) is non-negotiable
Read one standard book per topic (Laxmikanth for Polity, Bipin Chandra for History)
Make concise notes from day one — revision is key
The Hindu + PIB reading daily for current affairs
Write answer practice from Month 3 onwards
Choose optional wisely — pick based on interest + availability of material
